candidates.body: Ruby and Tyson added a mascot clause to their closing routine: the bakery cannot be locked up until any mascot is confirmed to be outside as well.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Creates a practical rule that can be tested or complicated if the mascot becomes real.

candidates.body: Tyson proposed installing a tiny bell to warn anyone reaching for the door without thinking, though Ruby dismissed it as a joke that would quickly become annoying.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Preserves a recurring gag or a possible future safety measure for the bakery.

candidates.body: Ruby admitted she would be deeply embarrassed if the future bakery mascot proved better at closing procedures than she and Tyson are.
candidates.narrative_gravity_note: Sets up an easy payoff if a mascot or mascot-like character later outperforms them at the routine.
